content: CoinGecko API for price fetching: Free public tier (no key) allows 5-15 calls/min. Free Demo account (API key, free to register) allows 30 calls/min and 10,000 calls/month. Price endpoint counts as 1 API credit per call. Suitable for personal tracker with on-demand price refresh. For a single-user app fetching prices for a handful of coins, 10k monthly calls is more than sufficient. Graceful degradation needed when API is unavailable — cost/IR data must not depend on live prices.
